
----------------------------------TAXIFY------------------------------------------

---------------Catelog of Our Available Services-----------------
--- From Taxify Vehicles, With the Best Drivers ---
- Taxify Shared: rides have a 20% discount for users willing to pick up another passenger before drop-off.
- Taxify Pink: rides are exclusively available for women and children.
- Taxify Silent: rides can be chosen at the standard rate for a quiet experience.

--- From Taxify Micro-Mobility Eletric, Be Your Own Driver ---
- Taxify Eletric Scooter: scooters must have 100% charge, or after 3 rides when battery is below or equal to 25% to start your journey.
- Taxify Eletric Bike: bikes mist have more than 50% charge to start yout journey.
